title: PostgreSQL + SQL
goal: Build durable relational-database foundations and query fluency for backend and AI systems.

project.name: School Management Database
project.prd: Design and query a normalized PostgreSQL database for students, courses, teachers, and enrollments.
project.architecture: PostgreSQL schema with constraints, indexes, and views; queried from psql and a small Python client.
tasks: Define scope
Build core features
Test and document
Ship and push to GitHub
